topics.topic: ESDM Ministerial Decree 365.K/MB.01/MEM.B/2026 restricting affiliate mining contractors
topics.known_state: ESDM Minister Bahlil Lahadalia issued Decree Number 365.K/MB.01/MEM.B/2026, set 18 September 2026, prohibiting IUP/IUPK holders from using mining services from subsidiaries and affiliated entities without government approval, requiring prioritization of licensed local contractors (IUJP), with exceptions for National Strategic Projects, smelter construction/downstreaming, and domestic mineral and coal supply; applications reviewed within 14 working days, approvals valid for the duration of the related service permit, governor approval possible for regional-authority permits, applicable also to Kontrak Karya and PKP2B holders, and revoking 2010 DGM&C Regulation Number 376. Analysts flag PTBA (SBS), AADI (SIS), RMKE (RMKO), NCKL, HRUM, CUAN, PTRO, ADRO (SIS), UNTR (PAMA) and DEWA as affected, while independent contractors like BUMA (DOID-owned) and UNTR may gain work.

topics.topic: VKTR PMHMETD I rights issue of up to Rp3 trillion
topics.known_state: VKTR plans to issue up to 15,000,000,000 new shares at Rp10 nominal, ratio 35:12, exercise price Rp200 per share (about 25.53% of fully paid-up capital), raising up to Rp3 trillion; about 66.86% of proceeds go to subsidiary PT Sarana Ekomobilias Indonesia for e-MaaS EV rental working capital, the rest for VKTR's EV inventory. BNBR (24.41% holder) will not exercise its 3,660,631,994 HMETD (Rp732.13 billion) and transfers them to PT Bakrie Capital Indonesia; BCI and PT Biofuel Indo Sumatra act as standby buyers for up to 11,339,368,006 shares (up to Rp2.27 trillion). OJK effective statement obtained 28 September 2026; Cum HMETD 6 October (regular/negotiation) and 8 October (cash), Ex HMETD 7 and 9 October, Record Date 8 October 2026 16:15 WIB, HMETD trading 12-16 and 19-23 October, final exercise 23 October 2026; non-exercising shareholders face up to 25.53% dilution.

topics.topic: INPS private placement of up to Rp125 billion without pre-emptive rights taken up by GIGP
topics.known_state: INPS plans a PMTHMETD of up to 1.25 billion new shares at Rp100 nominal and exercise price, raising up to Rp125 billion, fully taken up in cash by controlling shareholder PT Graha Inti Guna Persada, pending EGM approval on 3 November 2026 with implementation expected early December 2026. Proceeds: Rp99 billion (79.2%) for subsidiary capital injections, Rp21 billion (16.8%) to repay third-party debts of Rp21.09 billion (including Rp12.59 billion to PT Era Prima Utama), Rp5 billion (4%) for working capital. Context: capital deficit of Rp42.83 billion, negative net working capital of Rp26.94 billion, liabilities of Rp219.18 billion vs assets of Rp176.35 billion (124.3% ratio) as of 30 June 2026, net losses of Rp30.2 billion (2024) and Rp19.1 billion (2025). Post-placement GIGP ownership rises from 65.86% to 88.32%, public falls from 24.12% to 8.25%, maximum dilution 65.79%, pro forma equity projected at Rp82.17 billion and current ratio improving from 0.69x to 2.12x.

topics.topic: DPR enactment of the 2027 State Budget (RUU APBN 2027)
topics.known_state: The DPR officially enacted the 2027 State Budget with a fiscal deficit of Rp671.16 trillion (2.4% of GDP), revised state revenue of Rp3,435.1 trillion, and state spending of Rp4,106.2 trillion.

topics.topic: PermataBank divestment of its 15.07% stake in Honest
topics.known_state: PermataBank sold its entire stake in PT Honest Financial Technologies on 29 September 2026: 57,379 shares (15.07% of placed and paid-up capital) to individual buyer Tay Yao Nan for Rp77.56 billion. PermataBank said the divestment has no material impact. It was previously one of three investors in Honest alongside Village Global and Orico (Mizuho Financial Group), which led Honest's last US$100 million equity round completed in October 2025.

topics.topic: MAPA acquisition of Sports Direct Malaysia Sdn. Bhd. for around Rp2.5 trillion
topics.known_state: PT MAP Aktif Adiperkasa acquired Sports Direct Malaysia Sdn. Bhd. via subsidiary Athletica International Holdings Pte. Ltd. for around Rp2.5 trillion, strengthening its ASEAN exposure; analysts cite integration and funding needs, rupiah weakness, rising operating costs, and a shrinking Indonesian middle class as key risks.

topics.topic: MAPA H1-2026 financial results
topics.known_state: MAPA posted H1-2026 revenue up 15.1% YoY to about Rp10.12 trillion and net profit up 30.5% YoY to Rp864.4 billion. Domestic operations contributed Rp7.7 trillion (76% of consolidated revenue, +17.0% YoY); overseas: Philippines Rp1.2 trillion (+9%), Thailand +23% YoY, Vietnam Rp165 billion (+58% YoY), Singapore Rp207 billion (-23% YoY).

topics.topic: Indonesia Stock Exchange launch of short selling for five stocks from 1 October 2026
topics.known_state: BEI will open short selling for five LQ45 stocks starting 1 October 2026: ASII, BBCA, BRPT, BUMI, and INDF. Semesta Indovest Sekuritas and Ajaib Sekuritas qualified as the initial Exchange Members. Investors need short selling accounts with these brokers, initial margin collateral of at least 50% of transaction value or Rp50 million (whichever is higher), and securities lending agreements, per OJK Regulation Number 6 of 2024. BEI estimates the scheme could boost market liquidity by up to 17 percent.

topics.topic: WSKT Obligasi III 2021 Seri A Rp722 billion principal payment via government guarantee and subsequent Pefindo rating upgrade
topics.known_state: WSKT was unable to pay Rp722 billion in principal of Obligasi III Waskita Karya Tahun 2021 Seri A due 24 September 2026; the Government and PT Penjaminan Infrastruktur Indonesia paid bondholders via the guarantee mechanism under the National Economic Recovery Program, with settlement of WSKT's obligation to follow through right of recourse. Following confirmation of the government payment guarantee, Pefindo on 29 September 2026 raised WSKT's corporate rating from idCCC/CreditWatch Negative to idB (Negative outlook) and its Obligasi Berkelanjutan III Tahap II, III, IV and PUB IV Tahap I bonds to idB, while affirming Obligasi III and IV at idAAA(gg) and Sukuk Mudharabah I at idAAA(sy)(gg); Pefindo cautioned the rating remains constrained by WSKT's very weak financial profile. As of 30 June 2026 the Government owns 75.35% of WSKT (0.75% directly, 74.6% via Danantara).

topics.topic: CMNP H1-2026 financial results
topics.known_state: CMNP posted H1-2026 net profit attributable to owners of Rp455.02 billion, down 25.85% YoY from Rp613.67 billion, despite revenue rising 33.47% YoY from Rp2.19 trillion to Rp2.93 trillion, as cost of revenue rose from Rp1.23 trillion to Rp1.91 trillion and other expenses of Rp217.31 billion were recorded. Basic EPS fell to Rp70 from Rp102. As of 30 June 2026: total assets Rp27.77 trillion, total liabilities Rp10.87 trillion, total equity Rp16.89 trillion, cash and equivalents Rp75.55 billion (down from Rp502.44 billion a year earlier).

topics.topic: PART planned rights issue of up to Rp200 billion and buyback of up to Rp10 billion
topics.known_state: PART plans a PMHMETD rights issue of up to Rp200 billion targeted for Q1 2027, mainly for working capital, raw material purchases, production, and business development, subject to shareholder approval and OJK effective statement, plus a buyback of up to 10% of fully paid placed capital with a maximum budget of Rp10 billion over 12 months after EGM approval. PART is also expanding into non-automotive machinery applications (agriculture, food processing, waste processing). Context: 2025 sales of Rp369.59 billion (+38.23% from Rp267.38 billion) and net profit of Rp30.21 billion (+29.97% from Rp23.24 billion).

topics.topic: ANJT up to Rp2 trillion loan to subsidiary PT Adhitya Serayakorita
topics.known_state: ANJT signed a loan agreement on 25 September 2026 (disclosed 29 September 2026) for a non-revolving rupiah facility of up to Rp2 trillion to subsidiary PT Adhitya Serayakorita, maturing 30 June 2031, at 8.5% annual interest on outstanding principal, unsecured, equal to 46.95% of ANJT's equity of Rp4.25 trillion. Funds are for ASK's operational financing, working capital, refinancing of obligations, and other ANJT-approved purposes; the transaction reduces ANJT's cash and increases related-party receivables, exposing it to liquidity and credit risks.

topics.topic: ENRG rights issue of around Rp4.1 trillion
topics.known_state: ENRG will hold a rights issue of 13.3 billion new shares at an exercise price of Rp310 per share with a 2:1 ratio, targeting around Rp4.1 trillion. Proceeds will be lent to subsidiaries for exploration and development drilling, production facility construction and maintenance, and working capital, plus enhanced oil recovery, gas pipeline construction, field development, and gas processing facility construction. Non-exercising shareholders face maximum dilution of 33.33%.

topics.topic: CRAB fiscal year 2025 cash dividend of Rp2 per share
topics.known_state: CRAB approved at its AGM on 25 September 2026 in Medan a FY2025 cash dividend of Rp2 per share, totaling Rp3.9 billion (17.08% of 2025 net profit of Rp22.83 billion), payable 29 October 2026; cum/ex dates 5-6 October 2026 (regular and negotiation markets) and 7-8 October 2026 (cash market). The remaining Rp18.93 billion (82.92%) is retained as earnings.

topics.topic: CRAB board changes at 25 September 2026 AGM
topics.known_state: CRAB shareholders approved Beston Barto Siboro as President Director, replacing Gindra Tardy (now Commissioner), and appointed Pontas Pane as Independent Commissioner, at the AGM held 25 September 2026 in Medan.

topics.topic: ARKO US$38.79 million SMI financing for 20 MW Pongbembe hydropower project
topics.known_state: ARKO, via subsidiary PT Nosu Hydro, signed a US$38.79 million (Rp696.5 billion at Rp17,995 per US dollar) financing agreement with PT Sarana Multi Infrastruktur (Persero) on 25 September 2026 to fund the ongoing 20 MW Pongbembe run-of-river hydropower plant in Tana Toraja, South Sulawesi, its largest project to date (other plants range 5.4-10 MW). The financing exceeds 20% of ARKO's equity of Rp552.84 billion as of 30 June, making it a material transaction.

topics.topic: ARKO US$9.8 million SMI credit facility for solar power projects in Batam and Riau
topics.known_state: On 24 September 2026, ARKO obtained a US$9.8 million (Rp174.57 billion) credit facility from PT Sarana Multi Infrastruktur (Persero) for solar power projects in Batam and Riau owned by PT Endorshine Energy Solutions.

topics.topic: BNI up to Rp10.75 trillion credit extension to PT NexAI Digital Infrastruktur Tbk for data center development
topics.known_state: BBNI extended up to Rp10.75 trillion to NexAI (MGLV) through subsidiaries PT Nextier Askara Center (Rp4.13 trillion, six-year tenor) and PT Nextier GenAi Center (Rp6.63 trillion, seven-year tenor), each 99.9% owned by NexAI, at floating rates of 90-day compounded IndONIA plus 1.9%, to fund data center expansion to a combined 102 MW including the Jababeka facility and BatangDC. BNI acted as coordinating bank, mandated lead arranger and bookrunner, agent, and security agent, with collateral including land/building mortgages, fiducia, share pledges, and NexAI corporate guarantees. The facility is about 6.89% of BNI's core capital, joining jumbo exposures including Rp55 trillion to PT Agrinas Pangan, Rp38.4 trillion to the Ministry of Finance, Rp21.07 trillion to Perum BULOG, Rp20.71 trillion to BRI, and Rp16.21 trillion to PLN.

topics.topic: ASGR fiscal 2026 interim dividend of Rp297 per share
topics.known_state: ASGR set a fiscal 2026 interim dividend of Rp400.05 billion, or Rp297 per share, nearly 10 times the fiscal 2025 interim dividend of Rp30 per share, approved at an EGM on 25 September 2026. It will be paid from fiscal 2026 net profit (Rp138.45 billion as of June 2026, +30.37% YoY; revenue Rp1.56 trillion, +1.99% YoY) plus part of Rp1.72 trillion undesignated retained earnings. Cum/ex dates 7-8 October 2026 (regular and negotiation) and 9-12 October 2026 (cash), record date 9 October 2026 at 16:00 WIB, payment 22 October 2026. Yield is about 13.38% based on the Rp2,220 close on 29 September 2026; controlling shareholder Astra (76.87%) will receive up to Rp307.52 billion.

topics.topic: Tunggal Jaya Investama purchase of 11.89 million IMPC shares raising stake to 38.48%
topics.known_state: IMPC majority shareholder Tunggal Jaya Investama reported to OJK the purchase of 11,894,600 shares between 24-28 September 2026 for investment purposes: 4.6 million at Rp1,506 (24 September), 2 million at Rp1,431 (25 September), and 5,294,600 at Rp1,445 (28 September), totaling about Rp17.36 billion. Its stake rose from 21,115,805,494 to 21,127,700,094 shares, increasing ownership from 38.46% to 38.48% of voting rights.

topics.topic: TEBE operational performance through August 2026 and entry into coal trading
topics.known_state: TEBE reported hauling volume of 3.10 million tons and loading volume of 2.98 million tons through August 2026, including a monthly record of 585,000 tons hauled in August. Revenue through August 2026 reached Rp256.06 billion with net profit of Rp47.23 billion (Rp27.2 billion booked in July-August, exceeding H1-2026 net profit of Rp20.08 billion). H1-2026: revenue +3.5% YoY to Rp176.89 billion, net profit -27.6% to Rp20.08 billion on higher fuel prices and cost of revenue, with Coal Loading & Port Services contributing Rp82.63 billion (46.7% of revenue). The company completed its first coal trading shipment of 7,405.41 metric tons in Q3-2026.

topics.topic: Indonesia Stock Exchange lowering of minimum share price to Rp1
topics.known_state: The IDX implemented a minimum share price of Rp1 starting Monday, 28 September 2026, replacing the previous Rp50 floor.

topics.topic: GOTO planned cancellation of more than 32 billion treasury shares
topics.known_state: GOTO, with an authorized buyback of up to Rp3.5 trillion, plans subject to shareholder approval at an EGM on 14 October 2026 to cancel more than 32 billion treasury shares, about 2.7% of total issued shares.

topics.topic: PADA audited 1H-2026 financial results
topics.known_state: PADA reported audited 1H-2026 net profit of Rp1.81 billion, up 1,240% from Rp135 million in 1H-2025, with revenue up 81.6% YoY to Rp916.0 billion from Rp504.4 billion, driven by Courier Services (largest share), FTTH and PMO projects, Technical Services, and Call Center services; cost of revenue rose 81.9% to Rp882.0 billion. Per Stockbit Sekuritas data, PADA recorded a Q2-2026 net loss of Rp970 million, reversing from a Q1-2026 profit of around Rp3 billion.

topics.topic: BBCA bank-only net profit of Rp4.92 trillion in August 2026
topics.known_state: BBCA posted bank-only net profit of Rp4.92 trillion in August 2026, up 13.1% annually.

topics.topic: BBCA denial of acquisition rumor
topics.known_state: Responding to an IDX clarification request amid social media rumors that BCA would be acquired by Haji Isam, BCA management confirmed the information was untrue.

topics.topic: GEMS H1 2026 financial results
topics.known_state: GEMS reported H1 2026 (ended 30 June 2026) net profit of USD219.96 million, up 45% from USD151.67 million, with basic EPS rising to USD0.037 from USD0.026. Revenue grew 30.70% to USD1.49 billion, COGS rose to USD982.06 million, gross profit to USD513.22 million, and operating profit to USD298.64 million from USD199.9 million. Total assets reached USD1.43 billion (from USD1.19 billion at end-2025), equity USD852.7 million, total liabilities USD580.42 million.

topics.topic: RANC 1H-2026 financial results
topics.known_state: RANC narrowed its 1H-2026 net loss 57.42% to Rp15.28 billion from Rp35.89 billion, with basic loss per share at Rp10 vs Rp23. Revenue rose 10.34% to Rp1.6 trillion from Rp1.45 trillion, gross profit rose to Rp398.94 billion from Rp355.21 billion, and operating profit swung to Rp2.87 billion from an operating loss of Rp21.98 billion. Total equity fell to Rp249.77 billion from Rp265.29 billion, liabilities rose to Rp962.29 billion, and total assets grew to Rp1.21 trillion.

topics.topic: MDIA net loss widening as of 30 June 2026
topics.known_state: MDIA posted a net loss of Rp32.22 billion as of 30 June 2026, widening 183.87% from Rp11.35 billion a year earlier, with loss per share at Rp0.82 vs Rp0.29. Net revenue fell 8.55% to Rp281.82 billion from Rp308.17 billion, operating profit shrank to Rp36.2 billion from Rp60.83 billion, total assets declined to Rp2.9 trillion from Rp3.33 trillion at end of the previous year, and total equity fell to Rp916.15 billion.

topics.topic: Jhonlin Baratama acquisition of 30% BYAN stake with Low Tuck Kwong remaining controlling shareholder
topics.known_state: Low Tuck Kwong and Elaine Low signed a conditional sale and purchase agreement with PT Jhonlin Baratama as buyer on 16 September 2026 covering 10,000,000,500 BYAN common shares (30% stake). BYAN Director Alexander Ery Wibowo confirmed on 29 September 2026 that Low Tuck Kwong will remain main shareholder and controlling party, holding 6,951,170,541 shares (20.853%), with Elaine Low holding 3,799,584,529 shares (about 11.399%). The company has no plans to change its Boards and has not received any request for a shareholders' meeting on such changes.
